onboarding_modal.title: Test LLMs with AI requests
onboarding_modal.description: Try out your prompts with LLMs from <0>OpenAI, Google, Anthropic</0> and more.
onboarding_modal.step_1: Create a new AI request by clicking on ‘New’ in the sidebar.
onboarding_modal.step_2: Select an LLM model to work with.
onboarding_modal.step_3: Authorize and store your credentials in Vault.
onboarding_modal.step_4: Pass the user prompt and optionally, the system prompt and hit ‘Send’.
